infer: python scripts/infer.py --method MutInf --arm original --train-set qb --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MutInf/original/qb_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method MutInf --arm original --train-set qb --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MutInf/original/qb_full
